notes.title: Hotfix v2.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Marbles!
Version 2.0.1 brings the following changes:


 Fixed a bug where players would be duplicated when entering the training mode more than once per game session.
 Added a command to the developer console to duplicate players. Use this at your own risk, as it can cause weird behavior.
 Fixed a bug where the player customization preview would start playing the falling animation if returning to the menu while in a match.

notes.title: Sand Worm, new netcode and basic stage mod support - v2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello Marbles!
Version 2.0.0 brings improved network play, a new stage hazard for the Desert, basic stage mod support and new cosmetics.

General

 Network play has been improved in order to create a fair experience for all players and mitigate host advantage.
 Added a new loading screen that shows what stage is about to be played.
 Basic stage mod support allows players to create their own stages using the Unity editor and load them into the game externally. Stay tuned as more details will be given on the stage creation process, as well as Steam Workshop integration.

notes.title: Costumes are here! - v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello Marbles!
Version 1.2.0 brings the following changes:

General

 You can no longer lose coins while playing matches. Any debts that have been generated before this update will have to be paid off at the Ball Pit.
 Ground pounds now can only be performed if the player is charged, with the shock wave damage being scaled according to charge level.

Cosmetics
Costumes have been added! These completely change the look of your Marble at the cost of disabling the other customization options.

The following costumes have been added:

 Ubie
 The Eyeball

The following cosmetics have also been added:

 Frog Friend
 Demon Mask
 Loose Screws
 Realistic Nose
 Stylish Hair

Special thanks to W3 for providing 3D models for The Eyeball and all new cosmetics.

Stage: Smasher Ring

 Reduced size of death barrier.

Stage: Marmo's Pizza

 Reduced size of death barrier.
 Reduced hand speed.
 The hand can now be hit to prevent a slice from being grabbed.

Thank you for playing the game! Stay tuned for more fixes and content updates.
See you in the arena!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello Marbles!
Version 1.1.0 brings the following changes:
General

 Increased coin earn amount to 50 coins per point.
 Fixed music volume not being applied correctly on startup.
 Fixed UI button prompts not being displayed accurately when switching between keyboard and game pad.
 Fixed Discord game invites not working.
 Lobbies can now be joined from Steam without needing the game to be open beforehand.
 Fixed a stutter that occurred after the pre-game countdown.
 Game mode and stage select screens now remember the last selected option.
 Player 1's customization profile is now the default profile used in online play, no matter which input device is used.
 Charged attack now increases dash distance depending on charge level.

Stage: Marble Island

 Made cannon trajectory preview more accurate.
 Changed beach ball placement, as well as making it able to respawn if thrown off the stage.

Stage: Marmo's Pizza

 Stage hazards now propel the player upwards.

Thank you for playing the game! Stay tuned for more fixes and content updates.
Let's fight!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
The Marble Smashers demo has been updated, including revamped graphics, a new map, customization options and game modes.


 Revamped graphics: Some effects have been revised, and the maps have received a graphical update.
 New map (Marmo's Pizza): Fight against other Marbles on top of a pizza, but be careful! Every so often a piece of pizza will be removed from the level, reducing the playable area.
 Customization: Change your character's appearance with cosmetics, facial features and colors. Explore all the options!
 Game modes: Choose between three game modes that will change the rules of the game:

 Last Marble Standing: All players have only one life, and the last one alive wins.
 Timed: The game will progress until the timer runs out, and the player with the most points wins.
 Lives: All players will have three lives, and the last player to remain alive will win.



We hope you like this new demo.
Let's fight!
